attributes.action: Lower the age of Gender Affirming Hormone Therapy to 13
attributes.background:
Gender Affirming Hormone Therapy should be lowered to 13+ because gender dysphoria is visible at a very young age and people are at risk of things such as self harm, suicide and depression if they don't get the help they deserve
At the minimum, young people with Gillick Competence should be allowed

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about clinical policy on gender affirming hormones are a matter for NHS England, not the UK Government or Parliament.

NHS England published the clinical policy on its website, and has consulted on the proposals this year. 

https://www.england.nhs.uk/long-read/clinical-policy-prescribing-of-masculinising-and-feminising-hormones-for-children-and-adolescents-who-have-gender-incongruence-or-dysphoria-public-consultation-guide/

In a House of Lords debate on 23 October 2026, Health Minister Baroness Merron set out that the outcome of the consultation is under consideration.

https://hansard.parliament.uk/lords/2026-10-22/debates/6AEF0EB6-954C-43C0-8F9B-34C5F7783A95/PubertyBlockersAndCross-SexHormones#contribution-92863019-19B4-4D93-A532-6E486CBB7D48
